mechanism: The additive correction cannot express interactions among source coverage and latent-risk measurements. A shallow, strongly regularized boosted residual can learn these interactions while retaining frozen Kumo as the offset. Prior standalone CatBoost or fixed prediction blends did not test this exact stage.
evidence: ERROR_ANATOMY_v2.json: heterogeneous correction behavior by history support.
Original baseline correction improves KS but reduces AUC.
Correction bootstrap is negative: constrain depth and shrink contribution instead of expanding a large flexible model.
comparison: Same 18 head inputs, 6000 disjoint correction labels, two matched Kumo seeds, unchanged spline77 and .75/.25 probability blend.
acceptance: Positive pooled KS versus additive head on both Kumo seeds and their fixed mean; inspect fold consistency and conditional uncertainty. Otherwise reject without tuning.
